what: Eruvin 2005 list entries re-judged against Jeff's later rules by two independent Claude judges (opus, sonnet), 2026-11-08. NOT Jeff's rulings: a sensitivity denominator, kept apart from superseded_by_rule.json on purpose (that file is his words only, and judge_labelled_spans.py reads it as labels).
rule_for_exclusion: excluded = both judges said NOT_A_STORY. A split or any BORDERLINE stays in.
known_weakness: Consensus phase 1 (docs/findings/2026-09-28-consensus-phase1.md): this kind of judge over-rejects stories Jeff accepted. Here both judges reject 14 passages the detector found.
